Freeza sees their crossing of the exposed gap but does not see Bulma. Bulma tends Cargo's scraped knee; Gohan promises Dende to return and does so.

facts.statement: Goshin fights Dodoria away from the house, stops his mouth blast from reaching Piccolo and villagers, and turns fragments aside. While holding his then-chosen ki output, his shoulders and hands strengthen and his ki deepens; he forces Dodoria's arms apart and the body-and-ki gain remains after the struggle. The last village scouter reads 62,400 as an authored output snapshot, not a maximum or quantified measure of growth. He evades a tail reach, dents Dodoria's armour and leaves him on one knee, alive and breathing. facts.topic: chapter 39 Zarbon finds the intact ship
facts.statement: At the old eastern landing Zarbon and two soldiers question the surviving conscious scout. He reports Gohan's earlier 430 and Goshin's 520, says the pair later read lower, and reports Gohan's 14,600 before his own scouter was broken. He says the other child's reading was rising but did not see the other device's 36,800 display or a final figure. He distinguishes the boys by their actions, not names he has not learned, and also gives the ship's direction. Zarbon leaves one soldier to attend the unconscious scout; he and the other search the shore, find the intact closed ship under the inlet shelf by visual traces, and watch it. Zarbon reports the ship's location and condition through his scouter to the functioning chair-side soldier, who reports audibly to Freeza. Freeza orders the vessel kept intact; it is not secure, boarded or shown damaged. The 36,800 transmission remains unknown.

Gohan redirects the first shot into unoccupied ground, and Goshin stops the second until Freeza deliberately ends it. Freeza leaves his chair and faces the two brothers on the path; no full output or result follows. Bulma, Dende and Cargo are behind the rock; Piccolo directs Muri and the older resident back along the house, with other residents' complete safety unknown; Dodoria is alive with dented armour. One chair-side scouter works. The ball remains covered in the house; Freeza is not shown seeing its hiding place or possessing it.

facts.statement: Beside the lake Goshin's body and ki genuinely strengthen through the fight, including while he separates and redirects lifted stone; these gains already exist before he uses the technique and are distinct from it. He breaks one psychic restraint, drives Freeza back and cuts his cheek. Gohan independently attacks underwater, breaks stone, avoids the tail and creates spray that briefly interrupts Freeza's view. Freeza raises his ki afterward, pushing Gohan but not the boosted Goshin back. The last village scouter was already broken; no new reading is shown. On the branch's stated arithmetic, ×10 of greater than 68,600 implies greater than 686,000 on the same scale, not an exact measurement, and exceeds Freeza's self-stated 530,000 if compared as stated; their direct exchange reflects this. Goshin considers his known artificial moon but chooses the technique, partly because tailed Gohan should first be warned; no moon or transformation occurs. ×10 is this use, not a ceiling or proof of universal psychic immunity or all future matchups.

facts.topic: chapter 41 Piccolo, Dende, Nail and Katas
facts.statement: Piccolo carries Dende to the Great Elder’s high house. Nail questions them and stays to guard the elder as requested. Piccolo says Kami made Earth’s Dragon Balls and consents to the elder reading his past. The elder recognizes the child of Katas, says Katas was lost in the catastrophe and does not know whether he learned that his child reached Earth; he describes the earlier division and present Piccolo’s connection without conflating him with his father. Kami has not yet heard the answer. Dende chooses to accompany Piccolo back toward Muri, but they remain at the house at the last shown moment.
facts.source_class: authored branch adaptation; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 41 Piccolo awakened and elder’s balls
facts.statement: The Great Elder offers to awaken strength already dormant in Piccolo, who consents. Piccolo’s ki increases and remains stronger when the elder removes his hand; no reading, factor, equality with Freeza or universal recipient outcome is shown. The elder says the balls he made will disappear when he dies. His ball stays above the chair and is not given away. Dende has not used healing and Nail has not assimilated with anyone.
facts.source_class: authored branch adaptation; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 41 Freeza transformation and Kaiō-ken times twenty
facts.statement: Freeza creates a fan of shots toward the shore to gain a window, then begins changing while Goshin attacks his barrier and body. He completes a larger second form, claims over one million and physically overcomes Goshin’s earlier ×10 output; the transformed output is not scanned. Goshin consciously doubles the ongoing tenfold surge to ×20 on his already gathered unboosted ki, not twenty times the previous ×10, and gains a clear advantage. His body and ki genuinely gain further retained strength beneath the temporary technique, separate from the multiplier and prior development. He chips a horn and diverts Freeza’s village-directed sphere skyward without watching the unchecked sky; Freeza dives beneath the lake and Goshin follows with ×20 active. No maximum, compulsory injury, third form or final result is shown.
facts.source_class: authored branch adaptation; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 41 Earth choices and pod preparation
facts.statement: After Vegeta's attempted escape in Chapter 39, Goku asks Tien about the watch; Tien can watch but will not promise to stop a sufficiently recovered Vegeta without risking others. Goku intends to ask Kami and Popo and says he will not depart without a trustworthy arrangement. Chiaotzu remains with Nappa and Vegeta is awake. Chi-Chi, Krillin, Yamcha and Dr. Brief prepare to inspect the other pod; it has not yet been shown inspected or usable. Puar remains at the phone, and delivery of Chi-Chi's request to the boys is unshown.
facts.source_class: authored branch adaptation; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance
facts.previous_statement_before_vegeta_and_sna: Goku asks Tien about the watch; Tien can watch but will not promise to stop a sufficiently recovered Vegeta safely. Goku intends to ask Kami and Popo and says he will not depart without a trustworthy arrangement. Chiaotzu remains with Nappa and Vegeta is awake. Chi-Chi, Krillin, Yamcha and Dr. Brief prepare equipment and transport to inspect the other pod; they have not inspected it or established a usable craft. Puar remains at the home telephone. Chi-Chi accurately reports only Piccolo’s earlier time-bounded word about Bulma, and delivery of her request to the boys remains unshown.

facts.topic: chapter 41 exact frontier and unresolved consequences
facts.statement: Goshin, ordinary-sized and tailed, is underwater pursuing transformed Freeza with ×20 active. Gohan, tailed and ordinary-sized, is with Muri, Bulma and two newly found villagers by the low wall; Cargo and the older resident are at the hollow. Unconscious transformed Zarbon is breathing but not secured; Dodoria and downed soldiers are not reliably confined. Piccolo and Dende are at the Great Elder’s house with Nail and the elder; the visitors’ closed, intact ship is unattended by the inlet. Neither full evacuation nor Freeza’s defeat, new rescue craft, secured Earth custody, Ginyu summons, Raiti/Zākuro rescue, refugee fate or author acceptance is established.
facts.source_class: authored branch adaptation; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 42 underwater pursuit, anger and continued Kaiō-ken
facts.statement: From Chapter 41’s exact endpoint, Goshin pursues second-form Freeza underwater with ×20 already active; Freeza uses shots and lakebed rocks, and Goshin breaks that particular restraint, acts to protect the shore and carries their fight back above the water. His anger and vocal effort affect his actions. ×20 remains a temporary application while further unnumbered ordinary-body and ki strength grows and remains beneath it. He holds the direct advantage over this Freeza form; there is no new measurement, fixed future ceiling or blanket psychic immunity.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 42 Dende’s chosen potential awakening and healing
facts.statement: At the Great Elder’s house, Dende asks for and consents to an awakening of his own potential; the elder does not promise which gift it will yield. After Piccolo carries him back, Dende chooses to try and closes a living villager’s arm scrape and Cargo’s scraped knee. These are his first on-page branch healing uses, not proof of a universal limit, resurrection or an awakening already shown before Chapter 42. Gohan tells Goshin in Freeza’s hearing that Dende healed two people; Freeza explicitly notices a healer but does not identify his face or an exact grove location on-page.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 42 village response, ball, enemies and ship
facts.statement: A recovering village soldier who heard Muri name the ball attacks for the wrapped bundle; Gohan and Muri stop his immediate attack without securing him. Gohan and Piccolo each check one house and accompany Muri, Bulma, Cargo, Dende, the older resident and two newly found villagers to a sheltered grove. Muri keeps his ball; two adults watch approaches. Full evacuation and outlying workers remain unknown. Zarbon and Dodoria were last seen unconscious and unbound; the recovered soldier remains unsecured. The closed visitors’ ship remains last seen intact and unattended at the inlet.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 42 Earth-side pod inspection and provisional guard
facts.statement: Chi-Chi, Krillin, Yamcha and Dr. Brief reach the cordoned surviving Saiyan pod. An external scanner registers a field near the hatch, with its cause unknown; the pod is not opened and no safety, controls, air supply or usable craft is established. Puar remains at the Son-house phone. Goku and Tien remain last shown guarding awake Vegeta; Chiaotzu remains last shown by Nappa. The earlier requested message to the boys is not shown delivered; the whole Senzu remains last held by Krillin, with no shown use or transfer.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 42 Freeza’s further change and unresolved exchange
facts.statement: Gohan and Piccolo independently join the lake fight, using motion, water and aimed deflections without a claim they equal Freeza. Pressed by ×20 Goshin, Freeza diverts shots and chooses a further change. Goshin actively attacks and lands blows during the changing process; the new long-headed form completes and stops an initial punch before both fighters are thrown apart. Goshin remains ordinary-sized, tailed and red-aura boosted, flying at the still-active new form. No new scan, complete relative ranking, full power, defeat, fourth form or automatic future outcome is established.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: author complaint and selected emotion and technique correction
facts.statement: The author said Goshin’s anger and roar and other anime-like details were still missing and asked for Kaiō-ken to be examined before the next chapter. The selected unaccepted Chapters 39–41 receive contextual revisions: his vocal and bodily reactions arise from threats to people and Freeza’s disclosures, and the ×10/×20 techniques are embodied, directed surges rather than merely numerical switches. The corrections preserve Goshin’s own character, Gohan’s separate agency, prior readings and actual outcomes; no mandatory rage, injury or Goku-copy is imposed. Selected caption passages and official summaries/features were checked, not full audiovisual episodes. The exact prior Chapters 39–41 and accepted original Chapter 20 remain in the private predecessor.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author correction; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 43 third-form Freeza and the continued times-twenty fight
facts.statement: Goshin's Chapter 42 charge continues with ×20 active; he lands meaningful blows but Freeza's new long-headed form stops and drives him back in a direct contest, divides attacks and deliberately seeks the named healer. Goshin's shoulder is struck and he is breathing harder after the prolonged pursuit and fight. Freeza knows from Gohan that Dende healed two people and a group went to a grove. In Chapter 39 he saw the two children cross; whether he linked the name to a particular child or could recognize Dende is unestablished, and he does not know the moved group's exact location. No new scouter reading or full-power comparison is shown.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance
facts.previous_statement_before_ch45_audit: Goshin's Chapter 42 charge continues with ×20 active; he lands meaningful blows but Freeza's new long-headed form stops and drives him back in a direct contest, divides attacks and deliberately seeks the named healer. Goshin's shoulder is struck and he is breathing harder after the prolonged pursuit and fight. Freeza knows from Gohan that Dende healed two people and a group went to a grove; he has not identified Dende's face or exact location. No new scouter reading or full-power comparison is shown.

facts.topic: chapter 43 Gohan and Piccolo intervene independently
facts.statement: Freeza attacks Piccolo, striking his shoulder. Gohan's own Kamehameha catches the firing hand from the side long enough for Piccolo to move, without throwing Freeza away or establishing equal power. Freeza resists the wave; Gohan ends it. Piccolo stretches his arm to spoil a shot at Gohan, who helps him get free. Their timing and decisions matter; no Gohan Kaiō-ken or Nail assimilation is shown.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 43 times thirty, present exertion and retained development
facts.statement: Goshin raises his chosen unboosted power with temporary Kaiō-ken ×30, not thirty times the already boosted ×20. He clearly overpowers and damages the currently demonstrated long-headed Freeza in their direct exchange while directing shots away. His ordinary body and ki genuinely strengthen and remain when he releases the surge; the gain does not erase the breath and trembling resulting from this prolonged, intense fight. He subsequently chooses ×20 again to catch Freeza's wrist. No new scouter reading, permanent thirtyfold increase, fixed future growth or multiplier ceiling, obligatory injury, universal duration or final victory follows.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 43 village choices and temporarily bound soldier
facts.statement: The previously awake scouterless soldier follows the disturbed path to Muri's grove and seeks the wrapped ball. Muri, Kado, his companion and the older resident use numbers, the soldier's injured side, footing and straps to bind him to a tree for now; Bulma protects Cargo and provides her case strap. Dende chooses not to heal the hostile soldier while he might hurt them. Muri keeps the ball and heads toward a lower spring with Dende, Cargo, the older resident and Kado's companion; complete evacuation and the restraint's permanence are not established.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 43 ship recovery and bounded telephone relay
facts.statement: Kado carries Bulma toward the inlet under the trees; they avoid a still soldier and see no guard by the closed ship. Bulma uses the established recorder and controls to move the craft sideways until its aerial clears the shelf; she connects her communicator and reaches Puar at the Son house. She reports her and the ship's condition and what she knew when Gohan and Piccolo left, not the later fight. Puar says Chi-Chi and Krillin went to Brief's lab and no rescue craft is ready; after an unanswered lab call, he leaves with his note. Bulma begins moving the craft back under cover after Kado reports unexplained branch movement. No completed hiding, arrival of the message to the others, or departure is shown.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 43 external Earth test and divided frontier
facts.statement: At the cordoned pod Brief, Chi-Chi, Krillin and Yamcha continue external non-contact observation; fluctuating readings do not establish the field's cause, hatch safety, controls or a usable vessel. Freeza, still active, heads toward the village side but has not located the group. Gohan independently goes to warn them; Piccolo distracts Freeza and Goshin renews ×20 to catch his wrist. Gohan reaches the vacated grove and follows a trail past the still-bound soldier; he has not found Muri, Bulma or Kado. Goku and Tien were last shown watching awake Vegeta, Chiaotzu Nappa; the whole Senzu was last held by Krillin. The conflict, other villagers, message delivery and rescue remain open.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.statement: Dragon Ball Official's manga-based Goku technique compendium explicitly identifies Bending Kamehameha against Great Demon King Piccolo (Tale 157), Super Kamehameha (185) and Foot Kamehameha used for propulsion (188). These establish a source history prior to the Raditz story, not an independently viewed visual path in original-Z Episode 4, a power multiplier, or unshown techniques for the branch twins.
facts.source: Dragon Ball Official Goku technique compendium, https://en.dragon-ball-official.com/news/01_480.html

facts.topic: bounded manga editorial survey of Kamehameha applications
facts.statement: The official-site editors independently counted 67 manga Kamehameha scenes under expressly stated criteria and disclaimed an officially recognized statement of fact. They discuss hand propulsion, a stopped preparation, Goku's two underwater single-hand shots, silent uses and Gohan's later one-hand Cell response. Their scene-based count and interpretations do not establish a franchise-wide total, anime choreography or universal pose and pronunciation rules.
facts.source: Dragon Ball Official, Project Every X manga survey, https://en.dragon-ball-official.com/news/01_659.html
facts.source_class: official-site independent editorial investigation; explicit disclaimer; manga only

facts.topic: Kaiō-ken wave and corrected Z 92 caption cue
facts.statement: The retained Z 31 Japanese captions identify a ×3 Kaiō-ken Kamehameha at 12:07–12:18 and ×4 Kaiō-ken at 16:01–16:06. The retained Z 92 caption places King Kai's statement that Goku's ×20 exceeded his limit at 09:51–09:57, after a distinct 09:47–09:51 line about Freeza's strength. Toei's short Z 91–92 summaries identify the ×20 wave and Freeza's hand injury. These are distinct source witnesses and a specific Goku situation, not a fixed Goshin ceiling, compulsory injury or full visual/audio review.
facts.source_class: directly read redistributed Japanese caption cues with unverified origin/cut; separate official short synopses

facts.topic: later Kamehameha examples and game-specific names
facts.statement: Official manga-related profiles describe later Gohan's one-hand response to Cell and Goku's spiritual support, while their wording about the nature of that support differs. An official game comparison uses the Instant Transmission Kamehameha label; GT profiles identify Goku's 10× and Gogeta's Big Bang Kamehameha. Legends uses additional game-specific numbered move labels. These are later or separately situated accounts, not automatic techniques known at the selected Chapter 43 frontier or transferable fixed multipliers.
facts.source: Official Gohan and Cell profiles; Sparking! ZERO comparison; GT and Legends features, URLs in the Kamehameha study
facts.source_class: official manga-based, GT and game features, differentiated by medium

facts.topic: distinct ki attacks and attributed movie/Super reports
facts.statement: The official Saibaiman profile calls Krillin's attack Scattering Bullet, and the Vegeta profile calls the similar-looking attack Galick Gun; neither is automatically a Kamehameha. An official-site interview describes the separate Broly: Second Coming Family Kamehameha, and a secondary episode summary describes the later Super 116 Kefla slide. These do not establish a movie's metaphysics, a verified complete viewing or current branch possession.
facts.source_class: official manga-based features; attributed interview and secondary episode summary

facts.topic: chapter 43 debris staging and landing clarity correction
facts.statement: In the corrected unaccepted Chapter 43, Gohan sends one stone into the water; Goshin settles the remaining held stones on the empty side of the island and releases Kaiō-ken. Goshin lands and Gohan and Piccolo land beside him. Freeza listens for movement rather than voices not yet shown approaching. This resolves the duplicate/unshown caught-stone action, landing antecedent ambiguity and sound-sequence concern without changing the fight, demonstrated advantage, retained growth, renewed ×20 or character agency.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted prose; not source choreography

facts.topic: chapter 33–36 repetition correction without changing growth or custody
facts.statement: Shortened or varied selected repeated retained-growth and unsecured-shade explanations in Chapters 33–36. Goshin retains his existing real gains, hybrid nature and developing Talent; Vegeta's hands and tail remain free and the guards remain active. The earlier historical audit identified repetition as an editorial issue, not a change to those facts.
facts.source_class: authored editorial revision of unaccepted working prose

facts.statement: Gohan identifies Goku and Krillin as the people with Vegeta when the travellers left and expresses confidence about what they will do; Goshin identifies Tien and Chiaotzu as the people then with Nappa. This is not live surveillance or a custody change, and matches Gohan's explicit Chapter 34 uncertainty about later events.
facts.source_class: authored correction of unaccepted dialogue and character knowledge

facts.topic: Kamehameha branch capability map through chapter 43
facts.statement: Goku steers his wave in Chapter 5; Goshin learns by observation with more raw ki in that moment and less practiced control, then retains and refines steering and simultaneous stone control. Gohan asks Goshin to teach him in Chapter 19, learns and exercises his own wave, turns/stops it in Chapters 22–23, cooperates independently in Chapters 24–25 and interrupts Freeza in Chapter 43. Their established abilities, Goshin's real growth and Gohan's agency are retained; later source names do not automatically grant new moves or impose a ceiling.
facts.source: selected Chapters 5, 15, 19, 22–25, 43; linked Kamehameha research study
facts.source_class: authored selected-branch actions and author-directed first-wave comparison

facts.topic: chapter 44 renewed Kaiō-ken and Freeza’s smaller form
facts.statement: The ×20 wrist contest resumes at once. Goshin deliberately raises his selected unboosted output to ×30, strikes Freeza while he changes and follows him underwater. A smaller form emerges; both it and Goshin land blows while the ×30 is active. Goshin’s own body and ki genuinely strengthen further in the fight; after the red light falls briefly, this gain remains. He invokes the surge again for the pursuit without a stated new factor. The shoulder ache, rough breathing and blood taste are present, not a permanent ceiling, fixed injury rule, full-reserve measurement or result.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 44 curved wave, Piccolo and the inlet pursuit
facts.statement: Piccolo independently turns a shot away, helps Goshin clear another attack and uses spray and position to aid the fight. Goshin curves his established Kamehameha across Freeza’s shot away from Piccolo and cuts it off before it sweeps farther toward the shore. Freeza refers to the ship’s inlet location, which his soldier reported to him in Chapter 39, and heads that way; Goshin and Piccolo pursue. Their interception and the fight’s outcome are not shown.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 44 Gohan finds and warns the spring party
facts.statement: Gohan follows the trail and Kado’s companion to Muri, Dende, Cargo and an older resident at the lower spring. He tells Dende Freeza heard his healing report but he did not describe Dende, and admits uncertainty about what Freeza saw near the earlier house. Muri’s party chooses the screened channel; the older resident carries the wrapped ball, and Cargo and the companion leave a directional stone marker. Dende chooses to remain with the group while willing to help others. The whole village has not been found.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 44 the inlet soldier, ship and missing worker
facts.statement: A separate scouter-broken soldier, whom Bulma and Kado previously passed lying under trees, attacks the ship near the shelf. Gohan hears the shot, arrives, redirects his hand and knocks him unconscious with a physical strike; the man is breathing. Gohan and Kado bind him with a spare strap, not a guaranteed permanent restraint. The different grove soldier was last shown alive and temporarily bound. Kado’s friend and other residents remain uncounted. Bulma pilots the intact craft slowly away with Kado and Gohan aboard; external damage is not fully inspected.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 44 Puar delivers Bulma’s bounded message
facts.statement: Puar reaches Capsule Corporation, gets the police-cordoned pod-site address through reception and physically brings the note to Chi-Chi, Yamcha and Dr. Brief. Bulma reports that she is on Namek, with Kado and the intact ship when she called, and limits her account of the fight to what she saw before Gohan and Piccolo left to help Goshin. The pod test does not prove a safe hatch or usable craft. Puar sets off toward the home telephone and Krillin carries the bounded report to Goku.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance
facts.previous_statement_before_vegeta_and_sna: Puar reaches Capsule Corporation, gets the police-cordoned pod-site address through reception, and physically brings his note to Chi-Chi, Yamcha and Dr. Brief. Bulma’s report is limited to her and the intact ship’s condition and what she saw before Gohan and Piccolo left to help Goshin; she did not see the later fight. The external pod test continues without proving a safe hatch or usable craft. Puar sets off back toward the home telephone. Krillin goes to relay the same bounded report to Goku.

facts.topic: chapter 44 Earth report and unresolved watch request
facts.statement: Krillin explicitly tells Goku, within Vegeta's hearing, that Bulma says the travellers are on Namek and conveys her bounded report. Vegeta conditionally proposes denying Freeza a possible ball, seeks his own wish and offers to help in exchange for transport; Goku refuses to take a ball for him or hand over a ship, and asks King Kai to warn Piccolo if reachable. King Kai agrees to try; delivery is unshown. Tien asks Chiaotzu to seek watch help, then takes his place with Nappa while Goku and Krillin remain by Vegeta. Chiaotzu's arrival, secure custody, Chi-Chi's earlier message and a usable craft remain unshown; the whole Senzu is with Krillin.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance
facts.previous_statement_before_vegeta_and_sna: Krillin gives Goku Bulma’s bounded report at the quarry. Tien asks Chiaotzu to seek help from Kami and Popo with a watch; Goku specifies what information to relay and not to imply a ship exists. Tien moves to Nappa, while Goku and Krillin remain by awake Vegeta. Chiaotzu leaves; his arrival, their response and secure custody are not shown. Chi-Chi’s earlier message to the boys remains undelivered on-page, and the whole Senzu is still in Krillin’s pocket.

facts.topic: chapter 44 exact moving-ship frontier and remaining unknowns
facts.statement: Goshin and Piccolo pursue Freeza toward the inlet. Bulma is piloting the ship slowly between the trees with Gohan and Kado aboard; Gohan senses Freeza coming and warns her. Water rises beside the ship, without a specified cause or shown outcome. Muri, Dende, Cargo, the older resident carrying the covered ball and Kado’s companion are moving along the screened channel. Kado’s friend, the wider village, both soldiers’ continued restraint, Zarbon and Dodoria, the Great Elder, the watch and rescue remain unresolved. Both boys and Vegeta retain their tails; no new reading, wish, source death or safe Earth rescue craft is established.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.statement: In unaccepted Chapter 6 Vegeta privately recognizes Freeza as stronger and wants eternal life as a chance to survive and eventually defeat him. He keeps that plan to himself because a scouter might transmit; no omniscience, sure victory or complete transmission history follows.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.topic: revised warning, training and urgent return
facts.statement: In unaccepted Chapters 23–28 King Kai offers an uncertain tomorrow arrival estimate, Goku warns Earth and stays to finish training, and Kami cannot reach King Kai after the Saiyans land. Battle and rescue are intercut with training. In Chapter 28 King Kai discovers the mistaken estimate and stopped fight, alerts Kami, and Goku immediately returns using his established Kaiō-ken. No precise speed, arbitrary road delay or afterlife cap is imposed.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.statement: Popo brings the bags before Goku returns; Chi-Chi moves the folded blanket to Launch’s car before Bulma departs. Goku carries the capsule on the urgent return without eating on the way; he opens it and the family shares the food in Chapter 29.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.topic: Vegeta’s chosen limited care and separate Nappa watch
facts.statement: Vegeta refuses examination through Chapter 32, then independently requests and permits a limited, stoppable, needle-free examination of his side in Chapter 34 to recover for his own purposes. Dr. Mori cannot promise a cure or full diagnosis, and Goku and Krillin guard her route; Tien and Chiaotzu remain with Nappa, whose care is consensual and separate. Vegeta takes food in Chapter 35, drinks in Chapter 36 and declines another examination.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.statement: In Chapters 35 and 38 Vegeta suspects the travellers may have gone to Namek, wants to use Goshin’s strength, admits Freeza is stronger and seeks immortality as a chance to destroy him and rule. He bargains for his ship, gives limited scouter-search information and warns that Freeza may seek a further set if one exists. Goku refuses transport; no Namekian set, guaranteed victory or redemption is established.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.statement: In Chapter 39 injured Vegeta takes advantage of Krillin’s absence, fires into nearby ground and attempts to flee toward the city and his pod. Goku uses his established Kaiō-ken to intercept and restrain him, and Vegeta returns under guard. Tien and Chiaotzu stay with Nappa, who does not assist; in Chapter 41 Tien takes the attempt into account.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.topic: Namek confirmation and conditional denial plan
facts.statement: In Chapter 44 Krillin relays Bulma’s identification of Namek within Vegeta’s hearing. The prince proposes hiding one possible ball if the local rules require gathering them; he intends later to take the others and the wish himself, but does not know the Namekian set exists, its count, rules or custody. Goku refuses to acquire a ball for him or provide a ship, and asks King Kai to warn Piccolo if he can. King Kai will try; delivery is not shown.
facts.source_class: authored correction of selected unaccepted branch; source evidence separately bounded

facts.statement: Freeza deliberately lifts the inlet water toward the ship. Gohan braces its hull with ki while Kado gives a side-cut direction and Bulma pilots; a branch bends the aerial. Goshin hits Freeza and the water falls; Piccolo then deflects his aimed wrist. The ship lands temporarily behind a bank, its occupants unhit; its connection and full condition are not tested.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 45 screened channel and ball custody
facts.statement: Muri, Dende, Cargo, Kado’s companion and the older resident leave the channel for a higher shelf and young trees. The older resident keeps the covered ball, with the others briefly assisting across the obstacle. Dende asks about Gohan and Kado rather than claiming a remote report; the channel and ship parties have not reunited.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 45 cumulative growth and independent combat
facts.statement: Goshin continues his renewed temporary Kaiō-ken at an unstated factor. Freeza raises his own active output; Goshin’s body and ki genuinely strengthen further and the gain remains when he voluntarily lets the red light fade. He later renews the surge at an unstated factor. Gohan uses debris control, movement and a separate opening; Piccolo intervenes. No full-reserve number, permanent multiplication, fixed ceiling or fight outcome is established.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 45 Piccolo’s two-way relay and Kami’s answer
facts.statement: King Kai passes Goku’s warning about a possible ball to Piccolo, who says Freeza already knows Muri guards one but does not know its current position. Piccolo asks King Kai to tell Kami the Great Elder’s answer: his father was Katas, who died in the storms; whether Katas learned the child reached Earth is unknown. King Kai delivers this to Kami. Piccolo also says the boys were fighting beside him, not that everyone was safe; Kami’s request to thank Piccolo is not yet delivered.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.statement: Chiaotzu reaches the Lookout and honestly says he did not hear all the reports from across the tracks; he conveys the pod’s uncertainty and requests watch help. Kami accompanies him to the quarry, where Goku and Krillin watch Vegeta and Tien watches Nappa; Popo stays at the Lookout. Chi-Chi and Dr. Brief use a pole to test the scanner response from farther back without identifying its cause; Yamcha leaves for a second instrument. Puar returns to the home phone. A secure custody arrangement and usable craft remain unproven.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 45 missing worker and partially hidden ship
facts.statement: Kado finds his missing friend Sela, who hid near the watercourse after soldiers appeared. She recalls two others at the planting terrace before shooting but does not know their later fate. Sela, Kado and Bulma move the ship into a partly screened hollow; the bent aerial’s covering and support are damaged, and Bulma begins inspection. The ship’s complete hull, connection, spaceworthiness, future concealment and other residents’ safety are not established.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.statement: Goshin has renewed the red surge at an unstated factor and rushes the still-active Freeza above the lake. Gohan moves toward an opening at Freeza’s left and Piccolo raises his hands from the other side; the new clash and fight result are unshown. Both brothers and Vegeta retain tails. The separated ship and Muri groups, wider rescue, other enemies and previous promises remain open.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 45 chosen Namekian-ball disclosure to Vegeta
facts.statement: After King Kai reports Piccolo’s message, Goku deliberately tells Vegeta that a Namekian ball exists and Freeza knows, while withholding Muri’s name and the ball’s last known location. Vegeta can use that information in his own selfish plan but does not learn the set’s count, rules, present custody or precise location from this exchange.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: Z 51 Dende, eggs and Bulma's two-type question
facts.statement: In the retained Japanese Z 51 caption cues 167–178, approximately 19:02–19:51, Dende describes laying eggs from the mouth and does not understand Bulma's word for woman or her proposed two-type distinction; Bulma infers no man/woman division. This dialogue does not itself establish a prohibition on feminine pronouns, individual identity or expression. The current branch's portrayals are authored separately, and caption provenance and cut are unverified.
facts.source_class: directly examined redistributed Japanese caption cues; original source, cut and full audiovisual context unverified

facts.topic: post-Chapter-45 dialogue, antecedent and healer-knowledge audit
facts.statement: In the selected unaccepted Chapter 26, Goshin asks Vegeta to leave everyone alone rather than implying an unshown hostage; his ship offer and fight remain. In Chapter 36 Goshin is explicitly the person holding the access catch closed. In Chapter 38 Bulma asks Chi-Chi to call Bulma's own father Dr. Brief, matching the Earth scene. Chapter 43's source note and related active summaries qualify Freeza's knowledge: he saw Gohan with two children crossing in Chapter 39 and heard the name and healing report in Chapter 42, but whether he connected the name to a particular child or could recognize Dende is unestablished. No plot outcome or character identity is changed.
facts.source_class: authored clarity correction and bounded branch knowledge; not source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 the exact lake seam, offer and falling island
facts.statement: Goshin meets Freeza above the lake, Gohan independently uses the established left opening, and Piccolo intervenes from the other side. Freeza renews his offer of service to both boys and conditional safety to the threatened people; the boys reject him. He sends island pieces toward the shore: Goshin catches the largest, Gohan turns another into the water and Piccolo breaks a third.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 real growth and the lake victory
facts.statement: Goshin deliberately chooses temporary ×30 Kaiō-ken on his selected unboosted output and directs the contest away from the bank. Further genuine strength develops through his body and ki during the wave clash and remains when the red surge falls. His Kamehameha overcomes Freeza’s opposing attack; he bends the wave upward without watching the sky. Freeza falls alive and unconscious on the remaining island. Goshin, sore-shouldered and breathless, and Piccolo stay to watch; no secure restraint, full reserve, fixed cap or duration of unconsciousness is established.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 Gohan and Piccolo act independently
facts.statement: Gohan acts separately in the fight, directs a piece of island into the lake, proposes a distraction, uses spray and moving position, and interrupts a hand aimed at Piccolo. Piccolo extends his arm to catch Freeza’s tail and is burned on one forearm, though he moves his fingers. Gohan’s shoulder is hit but moves. These positioning-based contributions do not establish that either matches Goshin’s raw capability or that Freeza cannot sense ki.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 village reunion and aerial repair
facts.statement: Bulma repairs the aerial’s pulled contact and checks local continuity; a subsequent Earth call succeeds, though the entire hull and spaceworthiness remain untested. Kado follows the three-stone marker and rejoins Muri, Dende, Cargo, his companion and the older ball carrier under the young trees, then returns to Bulma and Sela with their limited news. Sela’s two terrace colleagues remain unaccounted for.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 family messages and the live call
facts.statement: King Kai passes Kami’s requested thanks and Chi-Chi’s earlier request to Piccolo; Piccolo tells both boys that their mother is trying to come and wants them home if they can. Gohan reaches Bulma’s ship and personally reports to Puar that Freeza is unconscious and that Goshin and Piccolo were on their feet when he left. He asks Puar to tell Chi-Chi he heard her message, wants to come home after looking for people, and loves her. Bulma reports her own condition and repaired call, retains the saved route, and does not claim the ship is ready to fly. Puar calls Capsule Corporation and returns to the phone; Yamcha carries the receptionist’s note to Chi-Chi and Brief.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 King Kai, Kami, Goku and Vegeta
facts.statement: Piccolo reports the limited lake result and planned search to King Kai, who tells Goku; Kami also hears that Piccolo received his thanks. Goku shares the bounded victory report aloud with Krillin and Vegeta, then Tien and Kami. Vegeta wants a ship to exploit Freeza’s unconsciousness and remains hostile; Goku refuses and does not disclose Muri’s identity, the ball’s present location, count or rules.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 Earth watch and second pod test
facts.statement: Kami joins Tien watching Nappa while Chiaotzu remains present and available for a message; Goku and Krillin continue to watch awake Vegeta. Yamcha returns to the pod site with a second instrument and the receptionist’s note. Chi-Chi and Brief remotely compare the two instrument responses; the cause is not identified and the pod is not opened. Secure Saiyan custody, safe transport and a usable rescue craft remain unproven. Krillin still has the whole Senzu; Popo remains last shown at the Lookout.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 terrace search and remaining village group
facts.statement: Gohan follows Kado and Sela to Muri’s group and gives a time-bounded account of the result and the observed injuries. Dende wants to help the fighters; Muri asks that the path be safe enough first, and Dende stays with the group. Gohan, Sela and Kado depart to search for the two missing terrace workers; no discovery is yet shown. Muri, Dende, Cargo, the older ball carrier and Kado’s companion remain under the young trees, and Bulma remains with the ship.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: chapter 46 Zarbon and the freed grove soldier
facts.statement: Unsecured Zarbon awakens near the village with a broken scouter, follows disturbed ground, finds and frees the grove soldier, and starts along the old trail with him. Zarbon recalls two earlier unidentified high readings but does not know Freeza’s present location or the lake result. The soldier says the elder went down a path with a bundle and a child followed later; neither is shown finding the group’s present location, the moved ship or Dende, or transmitting a new report. The distinct inlet soldier and Dodoria remain unresolved.
facts.source_class: authored branch; not unchanged source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: episode-one farm prologue, hay and farmer death
facts.statement: The detailed secondary Kanzenshuu episode-one account describes adults and children at a farmhouse with pink ostrich-like creatures, an approaching pod, a farmer forking hay into a pickup, and Raditz returning the fired bullet and killing the farmer. These are reports from one secondary source; the retained caption does not independently establish the silent action or death, and complete footage was not reviewed.
facts.source_class: secondary episode synopsis; complete audiovisual source not independently verified

facts.topic: episode-two moon wording and Great Ape sound
facts.statement: In the retained Japanese Episode 2 captions at 19:10–19:24, Raditz speaks of Saiyan power under a full moon and a cue labels a Great Ape roar. These provisional captions do not establish a particular silent image, an unspoken memory by Roshi, or the exact authored English statement that Saiyans change.
facts.source: Dragon_Ball_Z_002.srt, W-30, local cues at 19:10–19:24; origin and cut unverified
facts.source_class: redistributed Japanese caption wording and labelled sound; no complete audiovisual viewing

facts.topic: sequential opening correction: farm, axe and appearance
facts.statement: In the selected unaccepted Chapter One, authored farm play and the approaching pod precede the family; hay loading follows the secondary report. Goku visibly sets his axe in the block before Chi-Chi later removes it. Goshin retains his Goku-like face, Chi-Chi’s eyes and tail, and is shown about Gohan’s height with slightly broader shoulders; no eye colour or fixed clothing is assigned.
facts.source_class: authored branch and author design, informed by bounded secondary source

facts.topic: sequential opening correction: moon and island handoff
facts.statement: In unaccepted Chapter Two, Raditz says Saiyans change under a full moon and asks about Goku’s missing tail; Goku does not learn the specific form then. Roshi silently recalls seeing the child become a giant ape in the tournament, consistent with what he tells Goku in Chapter Eight; the memory does not communicate its contents to Goku or the boys. Goshin moves a step toward Goku while still holding Bulma’s hand, then acts at the existing Chapter Four handoff. The precise dialogue, private memory and two-child blocking are authored, not established Episode 2 images.
facts.source: selected Chapters Two and Eight; canon/SEQUENTIAL_OPENING_CORRECTION.md
facts.source_class: authored branch clarification; source caption separately bounded at C327

facts.topic: sequential opening correction: farmer and information path
facts.statement: The selected unaccepted Chapter One makes the farmer killed by Raditz’s returned shot before either boy arrives. In Chapter Four Gohan finds an unresponsive man beside the truck but does not see how he was hurt; in Chapter Six he tells the others, Krillin checks for breath and pulse, and Krillin tells adults at the nearby farm before heading for Korin. The people’s relationship to the farmer, any later arrangements, wish or revival are unshown. The death follows a single secondary episode account; the exact wound, response, knowledge and notification are authored.
facts.source: selected Chapters One, Four and Six; canon/SEQUENTIAL_OPENING_CORRECTION.md
facts.source_class: authored story and bounded follow-through informed by one secondary account

facts.topic: sequential continuation — clarified causality, routes and staging
facts.statement: In the selected unaccepted Chapters 7, 10, 11, 16, 22 and 24, Gohan’s ki visibly strikes the cliff; Gohan boards Nimbus and both brothers enter the sloping passage; Goshin spontaneously asks Goku about C-6’s eye; the family’s Chapter 16 morning begins at the Lookout; the target fragment is set on the path; and Krillin, Yamcha and Puar’s arrival at the bus is unambiguous. These are local authored clarifications, not new source outcomes, exclusive triggers, mandatory habits, limits or author acceptance.
facts.source_class: authored branch staging, not source canon or reader acceptance

facts.topic: sequential continuation — rescue, inherited growth and controlled training
facts.statement: In selected unaccepted Chapters 25–27, Yamcha’s guided ball breaks the Saibaiman’s grip before it explodes, and the rescued woman boards Bulma’s car while the two upstairs people travel on Popo’s carpet; each disembarks from the vehicle shown. In Chapter 31 Goshin retains the fight/giant-form gain in his own body and ki, consistent with his whole hybrid inheritance. In Chapter 32 he explicitly reserves much of his power in the first family spar; Kaiō-ken instruction builds on his already established ability to gather and direct ki, rather than being his first gathering. The chosen multipliers, retained growth, Gohan’s agency, guards and outcomes remain.
facts.source_class: authored branch staging and character continuity; not source canon or author acceptance

facts.topic: sequential continuation — radar state, Zarbon knowledge and Chapter 46 clarity
facts.statement: In selected unaccepted Chapter 35 Bulma switches the radar back on after turning it off at the ruin, before Piccolo reads the next signal; its later cell removal and her unexplained sound report remain. In Chapter 41 Zarbon notices the elder guarding a wrapped bundle and asks to inspect it, without claiming an established ball size or that Freeza already possesses balls. In Chapter 46 Gohan takes the established opening without an intrusive invitation aside and Cargo explains the marker directly to Kado. The action, frontier, cumulative whole-hybrid growth, independent Gohan agency and character knowledge remain otherwise unchanged.
facts.source_class: authored branch staging and character continuity; not source canon or author acceptance

strength_grades.D: nothing attests it: authored, and declared as such in the chapter
